design.purpose: A warm two-colour cowl for one adult, worked flat in half double crochet and seamed into a loop.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn
Ch 36 with green yarn and the 15 mm hook
Row 1: hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across, 34 hdc
Row 2: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 3: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 4: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 5: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 6: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 7: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Finish last hdc with blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm green tail
Row 8: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 9: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 10: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 11: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 12: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 13: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc
Row 14: ch 2, turn, hdc in each stitch across, 34 hdc, fasten off
Snip the blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Snip the green starting tail to 15 cm if longer
Fold panel, match short ends, slip stitch through both layers across
Weave each tail through nearby stitches with the hook, then trim
